title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover under load shedding
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Fix regression: SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover could thrash under sustained load shedding. Stabilizes backoff calculations, gate failover triggers during transient shedding, and adds safety metrics/alerts.
description:
Context: After a recent rollout of more aggressive load-shedding thresholds we observed regional failover storms and SLO enforcer thrashing when noisy tenants produced sustained shedding signals. This PR contains a hotfix to stabilize the SLO enforcer behavior under sustained load-shedding and reduce cascading regional failovers.

What this PR does: it introduces a time-weighted backoff for the SLO enforcer, adds a short-term hysteresis window to prevent immediate failover decisions during transient shedding spikes, caps concurrent in-flight failovers per region, and improves metric tagging so incidents can be diagnosed faster.

Changes include: code fixes in slo-enforcer backoff logic, k8s deployment tuning (readiness/gc settings), new integration tests for backoff and failover, and updated runbook for on-call.

Testing and rollout: ran extended integration tests with synthetic load (see tests/), staged rollout to canary and then all regions behind a runtime feature flag; feature flag removed after 6 hours of stable behavior in canaries.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduced thrash in integration harness and added a regression test
- [x] Implemented time-weighted backoff and regional caps
- [x] CI green after two reruns (one flaky test fixed)
- [x] Updated ops runbook and alert thresholds
- [x] Monitored canary for 6 hours before global rollout

Notes: This is scoped as a hotfix focused on operational stability. Follow-up items (ENG-4890) track longer-term improvements to the shedding policy and better tenant isolation.
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): implement time-weighted backoff to smooth reattempts; fix(slo-enforcer): add regional concurrent-failover caps and hysteresis window; infra(k8s): adjust slo-enforcer deployment readiness and terminationGracePeriod; test(slo): add integration tests for sustained shedding scenarios; docs(ops): update runbook with failover playbook
review_comments: Liam Chen: Question on tuning — do we need region-specific caps or is a global cap sufficient? Please justify the value choices in the commit message.

Aisha Kapoor (author): I tried both; region-specific caps were added because we observed the US-west region had much higher transient noise in the test harness. Added justification to the backoff.go header comment and unit tests that validate cap behavior.
Priya Anand: Can we add a short metric that counts suppressed failover decisions due to hysteresis? That will help on-call determine if hysteresis is masking a true-wide problem.
Aisha Kapoor (author): Added slo_enforcer_failover_suppressed_total metric and a dashboard tile in observability to track it.
Diego Morales: lgtm after CI is green and the flaky test is stabilized.
CI Bot: One flaky test (TestBackoffRace) failed on first run; subsequent run passed. All checks green.
ci_checks_summary: CI: lint -> unit tests -> integration (short) -> e2e(harness). First run: integration reported a flake (TestBackoffRace), rerun triggered by author patch fixed a race in backoff_test.go, second run passed all stages. Full e2e harness run in staging passed in 4 hours.
merge_summary: Merged by Priya Anand using squash merge after approvals from reviewers. Change log updated. Canary monitored for 6 hours; no regressions observed before global rollout.
